title: In a cloud session, wait-pid and wait-until run by bare name, because ~/.claude/bin is on PATH
why: Batch runner 8, 14:57 CST Nov 9 (via the coordinator): the waiter rule's remedy prints `wait-pid PID`, but in a cloud session it gave "command not found", so a background waiter failed silently.
note: PR #2351 (lane nfp-wait-tools-path, in batch 70) covers it: env_path_line in hooks/session_start.sh puts ~/.claude/bin first on PATH through CLAUDE_ENV_FILE at session start. Done when #2351 merges. Doing  CST Nov 10: open PR #2351 on branch nfp-wait-tools-path (triage live build).
